title: Indian Men, Women Shuttlers Likely to Face Japan in Asian Games Quarters
indian_angle: Indian badminton teams have learned their potential quarterfinal opponents at the Asian Games, with a strong chance of facing Japan.
summary: The badminton draws for the Asian Games were revealed, indicating that both the Indian men's and women's teams could face Japan in the quarterfinal stage after initial matches against Kazakhstan and Bangladesh respectively.

title: BAI Level-1 (Advanced) Coaches Course Underway in Guwahati & Raipur
indian_angle: This course is crucial for enhancing the coaching standards and development of badminton talent across India.
summary: The Badminton Association of India (BAI) is conducting a Level-1 (Advanced) Coaches Course at the National Center of Excellence in Guwahati and Raipur from September 14th to 23rd, 2026.

title: Women's Doubles Pair Change for World Junior Championships Selection Trials
indian_angle: This notification impacts young Indian women's doubles players vying for a spot in the prestigious BWF World Junior Championships.
summary: An important change has been announced regarding the women's doubles pair for the selection trials of the VICTOR BWF World Junior Championships 2026.

title: Indian Junior Team Coaching Camp for Badminton Asia U17 & U15 Championships
indian_angle: This camp at the National Center of Excellence is preparing India's top U17 and U15 junior players for upcoming continental championships.
summary: A coaching camp for the Indian team participating in the Badminton Asia U17 & U15 Junior Championships 2026 is being held at the National Center of Excellence in Guwahati.

title: BAI Adopts 3x15 Scoring System for Domestic Junior Tournaments
indian_angle: This significant rule change will affect all U-13, U-15, and U-17 domestic ranking tournaments and national championships in India.
summary: The Badminton Association of India (BAI) has announced the implementation of the 3x15 scoring system for domestic ranking tournaments and national championships across the U-13, U-15, and U-17 age groups.
